integrity: The Markov generator and rational formulas are explicitly defined, algebraically proved, and exactly checked in standalone finite cases. Finite checks are not infinite proofs. No independent scholarly audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for two exclusion sites with matched site-dependent boundary removal rates; no extension to longer chains, alternate reservoirs, or a thermodynamic limit. Relevant primary full-text priority comparison remains incomplete.
title: Exact global rectification-sign law for the two-site disordered exclusion channel
